There are no uses of eval, curl|bash, or other dangerous patterns, and all operations are confined to the build directory and pkgdir.

The package() function extracts a prebuilt tarball generated during the build phase and installs it under /opt, creating a symbolic link and desktop integration. This method is safe and typical for large applications like 3DSlicer. No network access or file operations outside the package directory occur during packaging. All dependencies are legitimate and required for the application's functionality. There is no evidence of obfuscation, backdoors, or unauthorized data exfiltration.
